column2: This workbook contains substantial data about every song to ever top the Billboard Hot 100 between August 4, 1958 and January 11, 2025. It was compiled by Chris Dalla Riva as he wrote the book Uncharted Territory: What Numbers Tell Us about the Biggest Hit Songs and Ourselves. It also often powers his newsletter Can't Get Much Higher. You can order a copy of the book here and read the newsletter here. If you use this data in any substantial way, please cite "Chris Dalla Riva." If you have any questions or issues, first consult the <Data Dictionary>. If it is not resolved there, please email cdallarivamusic [at] gmail.
If you use this dataset in a cool project, I'd love to hear about it. Email me what you worked on at cdallarivamusic [at] gmail [dot] com
